# e2b_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists E2B snapshots.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_snapshots" "sandbox" {
  sandbox_id = "sbx_123"
  limit      = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Optional maximum number of snapshots to return.
- `next_token` (String) Optional E2B pagination token.
- `sandbox_id` (String) Optional sandbox ID filter.

### Read-Only

- `snapshots` (Attributes List) Snapshots returned by E2B. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Snapshot ID.
- `names` (List of String) Names associated with the snapshot.
